caseStudies.title: Bank statement extraction pipeline
caseStudies.summary: Turns South African bank statement PDFs into clean transactions with Gemini.
caseStudies.problem: Credit teams typed transactions from bank statements by hand.
did: Built per-bank extractors with Gemini as a fallback
Fixed sign, digit and batching errors
Added validation, de-duplication and Excel export

Moved charts to ApexCharts and grids to AG Grid
